overview.description: The Wasatch Small/Mid Cap ETF (WSMD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in small- and mid-cap growth companies. The fund seeks long-term growth of capital. WSMD was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Wasatch.

holdings.infoBox: WSMD is an equity ETF with a total of 92 individual holdings. The top holdings are Halozyme Therapeutics stock at 2.32%, Manhattan Associates at 2.12%, Fabrinet at 2.01%, SharkNinja at 1.94%, and West Pharmaceutical Services at 1.82%.
